QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] A Wise Old Man
QuestInfo.0: You had your color stolen from you, just like the people in the Land of Contemplation. Oh no, does that mean you'll be stuck in this world forever?
QuestInfo.1: You meet an old man named Adler. Upon asking him about Maple World, he says he has something to give you and asks you to talk to him again after he's had a chance to find it.
QuestInfo.2: The old man named Adler gave you a #ekey#n and asked if that's what you've been looking for.
